mainEntity.name: Why does long-term immigration planning matter at the planning stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because clients usually need the topic translated into practical terms before they can decide what to do with it. Before the next step, long-term immigration planning usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
